target.title: fix(gateway): bound all-agent usage.cost concurrency to prevent SQLite starvation
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Unbounded concurrency in `Promise.all` when fetching usage across all agents exhausts SQLite connection pools or memory.

For deployments with 100+ agents, `agentIds.map(...)` in `loadAllAgentCostUsageSummary` creates an unbounded array of Promises that hit the database and cache simultaneously. This saturates the SQLite WAL lock/connection pool, leading to `SQLITE_BUSY` timeouts, or causes a memory spike that crashes the gateway process when the usage dashboard is loaded.

## Changes

Replace raw `Promise.all(agentIds.map(...))` in `loadAllAgentCostUsageSummary` with `runTasksWithConcurrency` (limit=12), matching the sibling `sessions.usage` pattern at `src/gateway/server-methods/usage.ts:1271`.

- Added constant `COST_USAGE_AGENT_LOAD_CONCURRENCY = 12`
- Uses `errorMode: "stop"` with proper error propagation via `throw agentLoadResult.firstError`
- All-agent aggregation semantics are preserved (same result iteration after bounded loading)

### Before

```typescript
const summaries = await Promise.all(
  agentIds.map((agentId) =>
    loadCostUsageSummaryFromCache({ ... }),
  ),
);
```

### After

```typescript
const agentLoadResult = await runTasksWithConcurrency({
  tasks: agentIds.map((agentId) => () =>
    loadCostUsageSummaryFromCache({ ... }),
  ),
  limit: COST_USAGE_AGENT_LOAD_CONCURRENCY,
  errorMode: "stop",
});
if (agentLoadResult.hasError) {
  throw agentLoadResult.firstError;
}
const summaries = agentLoadResult.results;
```

## Evidence

**Unit tests (104/104 passed):**

```
Test Files  2 passed (2)
     Tests  62 passed (62)  — usage.test.ts
     Tests  42 passed (42)  — usage.sessions-usage.test.ts
```

**Lint/type check:**
```
oxlint: no errors
```

**Real behavior proof:**

```
PROOF: usage.cost all-agent concurrency is bounded
Host: LIN-66D8BD4EA2C  PID: 317147
Time: 2026-07-07T11:01:18.396Z

─── 1. Bounded concurrency (limit=12, 25 agents) ───

  ✅ Peak in-flight (12) ≤ limit (12)
  ✅ Peak in-flight hits limit (12 === 12)
  ✅ All 25 agents aggregated (25/25)
  ✅ No errors (hasError=false)
    Duration: 27ms  |  Total calls: 25

─── 2. Unbounded Promise.all (old behavior, 25 agents) ───

  ✅ Peak in-flight = 25 (all start at once)
  ✅ All 25 results collected (25/25)
    Duration: 6ms  |  Total calls: 25

─── 3. Error propagation (errorMode: "stop") ───

  ✅ hasError is true
  ✅ firstError message matches
    Results: 2/3 completed
    First error: Error: simulated failure

RESULTS: 8 passed, 0 failed
```

- AI-assisted: Yes
- Fixes #101552
